description: An expander for Quad Algorithmic Rhythm, placed immediately to its right, that stretches some beats and squeezes others while the track's total time stays the same.

params.text: Applies this warping to that track of the Quad Algorithmic Rhythm; unlit, the track is left alone.
Sets how far apart the longest and shortest beats end up, 1 to 6; at 1 the beats keep their even spacing.
Scales the voltage at the warp amount input, -100% to +100%.
Sets the step the stretched and squeezed run starts on, 0 to 72.
Scales the voltage at the warp position input, -100% to +100%.
Sets how many steps the warped run covers; beats lengthen towards its middle and shorten again towards its end.
Scales the voltage at the warp length input, -100% to +100%.
Turns the warping on and off; off leaves the beats evenly spaced.

inputs.text: Voltage adds to the warp amount, 0.6 per volt at full attenuverter.
Voltage moves the step the warped run starts on, one step for every 7.3V at full attenuverter.
Voltage adds to the number of steps the warped run covers, one step for every 7.3V at full attenuverter.
A trigger turns the warping on, and a second trigger turns it off.

inputs.3: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
